data.name: OpenFilesTip
data.value: Open images or PDFs (multiple selection allowed, Ctrl+O). You can also drag and drop files onto the window.

data.name: ToolSelectTip
data.value: Select a mask to move or delete it (V)

data.name: UndoTip
data.value: Undo the last change on this page (Ctrl+Z)

data.name: DeleteSelectionTip
data.value: Delete the selected rectangle. For a candidate, turns it off (Delete)

data.name: RotateLeftTip
data.value: Rotate this page 90° to the left. Painted masks rotate with it (Ctrl+L)

data.name: RotateRightTip
data.value: Rotate this page 90° to the right. Painted masks rotate with it (Ctrl+R)

data.name: ZoomTip
data.value: Ctrl+wheel to zoom, wheel to scroll up/down, Shift+wheel to scroll sideways. Drag with the middle or right button, or Space+drag, to pan

data.name: EmptyTitle
data.value: Drop an image or PDF here

data.name: EmptySubtitle
data.value: Or choose one with “Open files”. Supported formats: JPEG / PNG / BMP / TIFF / PDF. Files are processed only on this PC and are never sent anywhere.

data.name: ChecklistHeading
data.value: Fields usually hidden on this document

data.name: ChecklistNote
data.value: Areas found automatically appear under “Auto-detected candidates” below (whether each starts on or off depends on the field). Paint any field that was not found by hand. The checkboxes are just reminders for you.

data.name: ChecklistTextDetect
data.value: Searched for automatically (paint it by hand if it is not found)

data.name: ChecklistPositioned
data.value: Suggested by its position on the card

data.name: ChecklistCropForPosition
data.value: Crop to the card to get a suggestion by position

data.name: ChecklistTextThenPosition
data.value: Searched for automatically (suggested by its position if not found)

data.name: ChecklistTextThenCrop
data.value: Searched for automatically (if not found, crop to the card to get a suggestion by position)

data.name: CandidatesEmpty
data.value: No candidates. Paint over anything that needs hiding by hand.

data.name: StatusDetecting
data.value: Looking for QR codes and barcodes…

data.name: StatusDetectFailed
data.value: Pages loaded: {0}. Some automatic detection could not run on {1} of them. Paint over anything that needs hiding by hand.

data.name: ImportErrorUnreadable
data.value: Couldn't read the file. It may be damaged or in a format that can't be opened. {0}

data.name: ImportErrorPageLimit
data.value: You can have up to {1} pages open at a time (this would make {0} pages, including the ones already open). Import fewer pages, or close the current work with “New document” first.

data.name: TempSourcePdfUnsupported
data.value: “{0}”: this development build can't read PDFs yet (images only).

data.name: PasswordRetryMessage
data.value: That password is incorrect. Enter the password for “{0}” again.

data.name: PasswordNote
data.value: The password is used only to open the file and is not saved.

data.name: ExportPdfNote
data.value: PDF export writes each page as an image. Text in the exported PDF can't be selected or searched.

data.name: ExportSeparateFilesNote
data.value: JPEG / PNG export writes a separate file for each page (_1, _2 … is added to the end of the file name).

data.name: ExportPreviewNote
data.value: The images below are exactly the redacted images that will be exported. Check every page for anything left uncovered before saving.

data.name: ExportZeroMaskWarning
data.value: Some pages have no masks. If you export as-is, the original information will remain.

data.name: ExportOverwriteMessage
data.value: These files already exist. Overwrite them? {0}

data.name: NewDocumentTip
data.value: Clear the screen while keeping the current work in “In-progress documents” (Ctrl+N)

data.name: LibraryStorageNote
data.value: In-progress documents (including the images before redaction) are stored only on this PC (%LOCALAPPDATA%\Fuseo\Library). They stay until you delete them.

data.name: LibraryOpenTip
data.value: Open this work (you can also double-click it)

data.name: LibraryUnreadableNote
data.value: It is damaged or saved in a different version's format. You can only delete it.

data.name: LibraryDeleteMessage
data.value: “{0}” will be deleted from this PC, including the images before redaction. This can't be undone.

data.name: LibraryDeleteAllMessage
data.value: All saved work ({0} items) will be deleted from this PC, including the images before redaction. This can't be undone.

data.name: StatusLibraryFailed
data.value: Couldn't read the list of saved work: {0}

data.name: SettingsTip
data.value: Set the display language and see where your work is stored

data.name: SettingsLanguageAuto
data.value: Automatic (Japanese if Windows is set to Japanese, otherwise English)

data.name: SettingsRestartNote
data.value: A change of display language takes effect after you restart the app.

data.name: SettingsStorageNote
data.value: In-progress documents (including the images before redaction) are stored only in the following folder on this PC. They stay until you delete them.

data.name: SettingsDeleteAllNote
data.value: Deletes all saved work from this PC, including the images before redaction. This can't be undone.

data.name: SettingsDeleteAllBlocked
data.value: You can't delete while a document is open. Close it with “New document” first.

data.name: AboutNoNetwork
data.value: This app never connects to the internet. Your files are processed only on this PC.

data.name: AboutUrlNote
data.value: This app does not open a web browser. Copy the address and paste it into your browser.

data.name: ClosingSaving
data.value: Saving your work… The app will close when it's done.

data.name: ImportErrorPageLimitFile
data.value: “{0}” has {1} pages. You can import up to {2} pages at a time.

data.name: ImportErrorHeic
data.value: Couldn't open “{0}” (HEIC). The “HEIF Image Extensions” from the Microsoft Store are required. If they are installed, the file may be damaged. You can also convert iPhone photos to JPEG before importing.

data.name: ImportErrorUnreadableFile
data.value: Couldn't read “{0}”. The file may be damaged or in an unsupported format.

data.name: ImportErrorUnsupportedFile
data.value: “{0}” is in an unsupported format (supported: JPEG / PNG / BMP / TIFF / HEIC / PDF).

data.name: CropTip
data.value: Pick the four corners of the document and keep only what is inside. Photos taken at an angle are straightened

data.name: CropInstruction
data.value: Drag the round handles onto the four corners of the document. Anything outside the frame is left out of the export.

data.name: CropInvalid
data.value: The corners cross or bend inward. Move the handles to fix the shape.

data.name: CropConfirmMessage
data.value: Changing the crop removes the areas you painted by hand on this page. QR codes are searched again on the cropped image. Use Undo to go back to before the crop.

data.name: StatusCropped
data.value: Cropped. Automatic detection was run again on the cropped image.

data.name: StatusCropDetectFailed
data.value: Cropped. Some automatic detection could not run. Paint over anything that needs hiding by hand.

data.name: AutoTypeBadgeTip
data.value: Detected automatically from the text. Choose another type if it is wrong.

data.name: OcrUnavailableNotice
data.value: Japanese text recognition is not installed, so numbers cannot be detected automatically (Settings › Time & language › Language & region › Japanese › Language options).

data.name: CropHint
data.value: Crop to the card and fields such as gender also become candidates by position.

data.name: RereadTextTip
data.value: Reads the text again in the current orientation and rebuilds the candidates (your own masks stay). If the orientation was wrong, rotate the page first.

data.name: StatusReread
data.value: Text read again and candidates rebuilt.

data.name: StatusRereadFailed
data.value: Could not read the text. Paint over anything that needs hiding by hand.

data.name: OpenFolderTip
data.value: Open all images and PDFs in a folder as a new work (subfolders are not included). You can also drop a folder onto the window.

data.name: FolderNoSupportedFiles
data.value: This folder has no files that can be imported (JPEG / PNG / BMP / TIFF / HEIC / PDF are supported; subfolders are not included).

data.name: FolderNoSupportedFilesSkipped
data.value: This folder has no files that can be imported ({0} unsupported files; JPEG / PNG / BMP / TIFF / HEIC / PDF are supported; subfolders are not included).

data.name: StatusOpenedAsNewWork
data.value: Opened as a new work (the previous work is kept in the list).

data.name: ViewTip
data.value: Use “Grid” to check the masks on every page. Click a cell to go back to editing that page.

data.name: ExportSeparateModeNote
data.value: After pressing Save, choose a destination folder. Each document is saved as “original name-masked”; if a file with the same name exists, -2, -3 … is added (nothing is overwritten and the original files are not changed).

data.name: ExportZeroMaskDocuments
data.value: Documents with pages that have no masks: {0}

data.name: ExportSeparateFailed
data.value: Saved {0} documents, but {1} could not be saved. {2}
